title: Is Weight Tying Still Beneficial for Decoder-Only LLMs in Private Settings Under DP-SGD?

one_line_essence: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.40335）：Is Weight Tying Still Beneficial for Decoder-Only LLMs in Private Settings Under DP-SGD? 系统研究 weight tying（input/output embedding 共享）在 differentially private fine-tuning 下的实际效果——'originally introduced for parameter efficiency + improved LM performance in non-private setting'但 DP-SGD 下 largely unexplored。是 security-governance × llm-evaluation × inference-serving 的'weight tying under DP-SGD'长尾理论资产——'当隐私约束改变时，原 non-private 的 design choice 是否仍成立'是 design audit 类问题；与 40361 Ranking-Aware Prompt Optimization 在'evaluation 目标多元化'层面同源；与昨日 security-governance 路线相接。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 DP-SGD 设置、weight tying 影响实证、decoder-only LM 跨规模验证。今日动作：长尾卡片维护。
